steps.text: Bang!

steps.name: Lively Child
steps.text: Whoa! That's amazing! You broke another record!

steps.name: Stubborn Child
steps.text: Hmph. Not bad, for a grown-up.

steps.name: Candid Stall Owner
steps.text: Congratulations! This plush is your prize!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hell yeah!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hey, Dawn Destroyer, you give this a try, too.

steps.name: Lively Child
steps.text: Liberi lady, is your name really Dawn Destroyer? That's so cool!

steps.name: Stubborn Child
steps.text: I think it's weird. It does sound a little cool, though. You good at shooting, too?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: First off, my name's not Dawn Destroyer.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Our beloved leader awarded you that codename herself! You should wear it with pride.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Secondly, we're adults. Breaking records at a balloon shooting booth isn't anything impressive.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Come on, give it a try. It's a toy gun that works on springs. Even a Liberi can handle it.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Thirdly, the attendant looks pissed.

steps.name: Still-Trying-to-be-Candid Stall Owner
steps.text: No, not at all. This is business. You win some, you lose some. Now, my Liberi friend, surely you're up for a try?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Ugh... alright.
Bang!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Whoa, the grand prize.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You win some, you lose some. Right?

steps.name: Lively Child
steps.text: Whoa! An all-you-can-eat coupon, good for a whole year! Works at all the dessert shops in Laterano, too!

steps.name: Stubborn Child
steps.text: A-Amazing! You gotta be a sniper or something at the Guards, right?!

steps.name: Lively Child
steps.text: Are you a big shot from a monastery?

steps.name: Not-So-Candid Stall Owner
steps.text: Y-You wouldn't happen to be... working for His Holiness...?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Thanks for the coupon, senior. I won't complain about how you tampered with the toy gun.

steps.name: Trying-to-Smile-Anyway Stall Owner
steps.text: Um, ma'am... I-If you don't mind... would you... would you tell me your name...?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Me? I thought you guys already knew.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: My name is...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Dawn—

steps.name: Children
steps.text: Destroyer!!!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Dawn—

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Destroyer!!!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Mostima, are you done?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But you were having fun too.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I was just...!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: *Sigh*... Whatever, suit yourself.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Giving in already? I thought you'd put up more of a fight.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: There's no point in putting up a fight you can't win, and I was never going to win, trying to argue with you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So? How does it feel to be back home? Good?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It's not so bad, if it's a once in a while thing.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You're actually pretty fond of Laterano, aren't you?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Who isn't? Even an idiot can tell Laterano's a paradise.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Even though you aren't allowed to stay in the city if you have Oripathy, your Lateran citizenship gets you out of most trouble.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Of course, it's a whole different story if you're unlucky enough to have sugar sensitivity, or if you're fallen.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hey, I like it here too.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You like it everywhere. Honestly, you don't seem to ever care where you are.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There's a saying for that. 'Going with the flow.'

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Right, right. You're a real charming one, Miss Nuncio, never one to stop in one place.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But you aren't like me, Fiammetta.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You have a choice.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So you should at least go meet that guest of ours. He's waited a long time already.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I've got nothing to say to a Gun-Knight.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How about to your teacher, then?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It's been years since I graduated.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What about your loving nonno, then?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: That's just what he calls himself.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Tell you the truth, I really don't want to fight over a gal with a Gun-Knight. If I end up on their bad side, I might get myself a weird codename too.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Anyway, now that we've been everywhere worth going in the city, I'm gonna wait for you outside.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Hey, Mostima! Mostima!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Grr, that bitch. She used Arts on me, didn't she? Why am I moving so slowly?!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: My opinion of Mostima has just gone up a little bit. At the very least, she's a good kid who knows to respect her elders.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Gun-Knight Patrizion, it's been a while.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Yes it has—

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: The light in the darkness, the shadow in the morning light, my most beloved student, Dawn Destroyer!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I am... honored.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Fia! Fia!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Looking just the same as always.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Me? I so rarely hear such sweet talk out of you.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: No, I'm talking about the monastery. You're wearing a helmet, Reverend Gun-Knight.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: As if I have a choice? Apostolic Knights are required to wear full armor on the job.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You're on the job?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: What? I can't come see my beloved granddaughter just because I'm on the job? That would be outrageous!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Reverend Gun-Knight, you're a Sankta, and I'm a Liberi. We are not related by blood.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Enough! My Fia would never speak to me like this! When your parents left you in my care, you wouldn't have dared to be so impolite!

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You were only so tall back then, like a little pea...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I was already seven when I first met you.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Do you remember how I taught you how to aim, how to shoot, how to calculate a bullet's trajectory? I feel like it was just last year...

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You were always pestering me to teach you how to use a gun, then, hah, you always came crying after you blew yourself up!

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: It's only been a few short years, and now everyone everywhere knows my little Fia as the Hardship Overseer... No, the Sticky Shimmering... Weevil? What's your new codename again?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: ...Dawn Destroyer.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Ah, right. I'm getting on in years. Even though I remembered it just a minute ago... Can't you settle on a single codename?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Wasn't it you miserable old men who decided I had to change my codename every month?!

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Did that happen? I don't recall.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Can I request to have that requirement lifted, then?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Lemuen is in charge of you, now. I've got no say.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Anyway! You were so adorable then, but you couldn't be more dull these days. Even the movies you bring back are getting more and more boring.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Hm... Maybe except the 'One-Armed Chainsaw Guy.' That gets three out of five stars from me.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: —Phew.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: So, my most respected, beloved Reverend Gun-Knight Patrizion. What did you summon me for?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm very busy, and I still have a lot of missions that I need to carry out.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: What missions? Strolling around the streets with Mostima?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: My mission is to keep an eye on the fallen angel Mostima, to make sure she does not leak any confidential information to anyone.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Enough, Fia. We don't have any secrets so important to keep under wraps.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Besides, even if we did, how would you determine what must be kept and what's okay to reveal? You say you're keeping an eye on her, but how do you decide what crosses the line, and what's okay?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm just following...

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Fiammetta, I'll be honest with you.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: The life you lead right now is pointless.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You have no right to judge my life.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I do. After all, I am the head of the monastery, your teacher, and your guardian. Above all, I know what you could've been.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Right now, you're diddling away your time, idling all day, doing nothing. Worse, you aren't even enjoying your life.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But... Mostima needs my help.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Fia, it's not Mostima who needs you. You are the one who needs her. You've found yourself an excuse to follow her around.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: This is Mostima we are talking about. She knows how to take care of her own problems.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Of course, when she tries on clothes, she might need someone help her with the zippers on the back.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Patrizion, you...!

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Angry? Finally, you found yourself some backbone. You should know I had very high hopes for you.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: After all, you're my most beloved student. You were the first Liberi who could've become an Apostolic Knight.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You could've taken on so much more responsibility.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Now, even if I don't make it sound so scary, it's actually pretty fun to be a Gun-Knight! You're not a Sankta, and you don't have this annoying halo over your head. The helmets wouldn't give you a headache.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You can't wield a gun, but we can get you a huge-ass grenade launcher just as easily.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Most importantly, Gun-Knights don't have to pay out of pocket when they blow up a street!

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Fia, you have both talent and experience. You should come back. Laterano needs you.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But I don't want to be a Gun-Knight.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: That's not what you told me when you were little. You begged me to train you so that you could become...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: ...an adult. Just so I could know the choices I had open to me.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: And you chose to follow Mostima around?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: At first, it might actually have been guilt that drove me to follow her around. I felt I was partly responsible for her becoming fallen. I was worried she would be so depressed that she'd truly fall.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You didn't understand her well enough, then.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Right, haha. It's Mostima we're talking about...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Then, I started to think. Andoain was bound to go looking for her one day. If I stayed by her side, I would eventually get to settle my score with him.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: And you finally found him at the Summit of Nations two days ago.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It wasn't enough. He got away. If I see him again, I will take him in myself.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Then you truly have no reason to keep following Mostima around. You could become an executor. That way, you can travel across the land on this case.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: No, that's not what I meant.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: After I got back this time, I suddenly realized Mostima and I have been so many places and met so many people. Set aside all objectives and purposes, and that in itself is my choice.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: You said it yourself: even an idiot can tell Laterano's a paradise.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Right, but if you've never been away from home, how would you know what it means to come home? There are lots of places that stir my heart more than Laterano, but there will only ever be one Laterano.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Besides, this journey actually isn't all that bad.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It's true. I don't enjoy my life.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm just going through it.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: That's not going to lead to any growth. You're just suffering for no reason.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Fia, all of us want you to stay. We can easily get you a seat on the Gun-Knights' Tribunal.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I'd even be okay with it if you wanted to go nuts and become a cardinal like Lemuen. I could talk to His Holiness about it.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: It's a lot more work than being an Apostolic Knight, but it's much better than having to bustle around outside.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Or I could simply order you to stay.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You won't. You're you, after all.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Right, because I watched you grow up.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: It feels terrible to be old.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I can feel myself going downhill, day after day. Every morning, I wake up, and I find myself worse off than the day before, and everything is leaving me behind...

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: My friends are dying, one by one. My students are scattered all across the world. The clerics simply respect me; they rarely come talk to me.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: It's boring, Fia. It's very boring. All I can do these days is chew over what's left of those days gone by, until nothing is left but some fuzzy feelings, to the point that I forget what I was trying to remember in the first place.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Eight years ago, you were there outside my door when I was packing.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: How'd you figure?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Because you left a long list of movies in my bag.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Oh, now that you mention it, I did do that.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I was obsessed with the Wrankwood blockbusters at the time. I only let you go because I was too caught up in the movies, and I started regretting it the very next day!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You only regretted it because you realized that even if I was going to bring you any of those movies, it wouldn't be for several years, didn't you?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: That's my girl. You know me well.

steps.name: Fiammetta & Patrizion
steps.text: Hahahahaha.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Haha, you just want someone to take over your work, so you can hole up in the monastery and watch movies, don't you?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Maybe, but I'll eventually run out of movies to watch.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: When are you leaving this time?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: In a bit.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Why not stay a couple more days? There's going to be another blindfolded handstand shooting match in just a few.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'll pass. I watched more than enough of those back when I was a kid. I even entered one.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: I remember that. You got first place. I still have the trophy in the back.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Really? You do?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Looks like I'll have to watch the match alone.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Don't make yourself sound like such a poor, neglected grandparent. We both know you'll have the friars with you.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Sure enough.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I heard they're making a new One-Armed Chainsaw movie. I'll bring you a copy the next time I come back.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: When will that be?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Probably next year.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: The movie will be so old by then.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: At least you'll actually get to watch it.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It's getting late.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Fia!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What is it, old man?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Forget it. Never you mind. Go!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Well, then. Reverend Gun-Knight Patrizion, I shall take my leave now.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Goodbye, I await your next visit—

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Dawn Destroyer.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I will burn your whole monastery down.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Fia, it's a joke! Just a joke!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Am I really this unlucky?

steps.name: Ferocious Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: Hah! A Sankta all by her lonesome! Looks like we're in luck!

steps.name: Ferocious Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: Tell me, how do you want to die?

steps.name: Ferocious Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: How come this Sankta has horns?

steps.name: Ferocious Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: Hah, who cares?! We'll find out after we kill her!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hey, I'm in a bit of a hurry. Can we not do this?

steps.name: Ferocious Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: Begging for mercy now? Not a chance! It's because of you Sankta bastards that my boss—

steps.name: Ferocious Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: What the—?!

steps.name: Ferocious Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: Aagh!
Now do you know how much work it takes to make sure everything's smooth sailing when you're out doing whatever?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Whoa! No way! It's the Dawn—

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You aren't tired of that joke yet?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm getting there.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I went on ahead since I figured that'd take you a couple more days. I mean, the old man came to take his granddaughter in.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It didn't cross your mind that I could just end up staying?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No way.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You still gotta make sure I don't spill any secrets.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: The old man has a message for you. Apparently he wants to do a movie marathon the next time we're back in Laterano.

steps.name: Panicking Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: W-What the hell? There's just the two of them!

steps.name: Hot-Headed Sarkaz Bandit
steps.text: Let's get them!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Well, I'm honored.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I will think about it.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: *Sigh*... Guess I'll take a stroll.

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Hm? An all-you-can-eat dessert coupon? Good for a whole year?! What is this doing in my pocket?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Did I win a prize? Perhaps His Holiness gave it to me a couple days ago?

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: Oh, who cares. Time to stuff my face with sweets!

steps.name: Patrizion
steps.text: She'll be back by the time this certificate expires...
